for i in range(max_steps):
    # Go to next song
    next_result = apis.spotify.next_song(access_token=spotify_token)
    print(f"Step {i+1}: next_song -> {next_result}")
    # Get current song after advancing
    current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=spotify_token)
    print(f"Current song: {current['song_id']} - {current['title']}")
    if current['song_id'] in downloaded_ids:
        print(f"Found downloaded song: {current['song_id']} - {current['title']}")
        break
else:
